title: Proper direct image and relative potential evaluation biduality
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $r\geq1$, and $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/\ell^r\mathbf Z$. Let $f:Y\to X$ be a proper morphism between finite-dimensional Noetherian excellent schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-exc-excellent-ring, def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Fix a dimension function $\delta_X$ and a pinned potential complex $K_X$ [def-per-potential-dualizing-complex]. Use the ordinary small etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the proper direct image $Rf_*$, and its exceptional right adjoint $f^!$; for a proper map compact support $Rf_!$ is $Rf_*$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. Give $K_Y=f^!K_X$ its induced potential pinnings for $\delta_Y(y)=\delta_X(f(y))+\operatorname{trdeg}_{\kappa(f(y))}\kappa(y)$ [lem-per-potential-dualizing-finite-pullback]. Put $D_T=R\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(-,K_T)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], and assume $D_X,D_Y$ preserve $D^b_c$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. For every $M\in D^b_c(Y_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ the pairing
$$Rf_*D_YM\otimes^L Rf_*M\longrightarrow Rf_*(D_YM\otimes^L M)\longrightarrow Rf_*K_Y\longrightarrow K_X$$
(the first arrow is the direct-image tensor map adjoint to the two pullback counits, and the last is the $Rf_*\dashv f^!$ counit) has an invertible internal-Hom transpose
$$a_M:Rf_*D_YM\xrightarrow{\sim}D_XRf_*M.$$
Write $\eta^T_N:N\to D_T^2N$ for the transpose of evaluation after tensor symmetry. The canonical iteration
$$b_M=D_X(a_M^{-1})\circ a_{D_YM}:Rf_*D_Y^2M\xrightarrow{\sim}D_X^2Rf_*M$$
satisfies $b_M\circ Rf_*\eta^Y_M=\eta^X_{Rf_*M}$. No biduality isomorphism is assumed on either scheme.

source.place: Expose XVII, proof of Proposition 6.4.2, printed p.298: proper-image comparison of the biduality cone; interpreted by the relative adjunction and projection-formula argument, not by an absolute dualizing base

proof.text: Write $P=f^{-1}$, $F=Rf_*$, $G=f^!$, and $H_T(A,B)=R\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(A,B)$; suppress $\otimes^L_\Lambda$ to $\otimes$. A proper morphism is separated and of finite type, and $f=f\circ\mathrm{id}_Y$ is a compactification. Thus the finite-ring, Noetherian hypotheses of the ordinary-etale internal adjunction apply. For this compactification $Rf_!=F$. The counit-compatible uniqueness of right adjoints identifies its $f^\times$ with the $G$ in the statement; throughout use that identification, so its exceptional counit is $\tau:FGK_X\to K_X$. The potential-pullback theorem applies to this compactification and gives exactly the indicated pinnings on $K_Y=GK_X$ for the displayed $\delta_Y$. No absolute dualizing base or evaluation isomorphism is used.

source.place: Proof: canonical internal adjunction via the natural Hom bijections and evaluation/counit formula; relative specialization for proper f

proof.text:
Let $\varepsilon_A:PFA\to A$ be the ordinary counit. The inverse-image tensor comparison identifies $P(FA\otimes FB)$ with $PFA\otimes PFB$. Define $\mu_{A,B}:FA\otimes FB\to F(A\otimes B)$ to have adjoint $\varepsilon_A\otimes\varepsilon_B$. This is the first map in the displayed evaluation--counit pairing. Naturality of the counit gives, for $u:A\to A'$ and $v:B\to B'$,
$$F(u\otimes v)\mu_{A,B}=\mu_{A',B'}(Fu\otimes Fv).$$
Also $F(\sigma_{A,B})\mu_{A,B}=\mu_{B,A}\sigma_{FA,FB}$: take ordinary adjoints, use naturality of $\sigma$, and both sides become $(\varepsilon_B\otimes\varepsilon_A)\sigma_{PFA,PFB}$. The inverse-image comparison respects this symmetry: on total tensors the degree-$(p,q)$ swap has the same sign $(-1)^{pq}$ before and after the exact inverse image. Finally let $\Pi_{Q,B}:Q\otimes FB\to F(PQ\otimes B)$ be the normalized proper projection map. The projection-adjunct lemma, with $a=1_{FB}$, and naturality of ordinary adjunction show
$$\mu_{A,B}=F(\varepsilon_A\otimes1_B)\Pi_{FA,B}:$$
the adjoint of the right side is again $\varepsilon_A\otimes\varepsilon_B$. These are identities of the specified maps, not choices of isomorphisms.

source.place: Proof: canonical internal adjunction via the natural Hom bijections and evaluation/counit formula; relative specialization for proper f

proof.text:
Put $e_M:D_YM\otimes M\to K_Y$ for evaluation and $\rho_M=\tau\circ F(e_M)\circ\mu_{D_YM,M}$. The general internal adjunction supplies an isomorphism $\alpha_M:FD_YM\xrightarrow{\sim}D_XFM$ for every ambient $M$. Its evaluation-normalization lemma, applied with $Q=FD_YM$ and $h=1$, says its tensor--Hom transpose is
$$\tau\circ F\bigl(e_M\circ(\varepsilon_{D_YM}\otimes1_M)\bigr)\circ\Pi_{FD_YM,M}.$$
The last identity of step 2 identifies this composite with $\rho_M$. Hence $\alpha_M$ is precisely $a_M$, by the tensor--Hom bijection. In particular the pairing specified in the statement has invertible transpose. The argument applies to $D_YM$ as well; the assumed preservation of $D^b_c$ ensures that $D_YM$ is an allowed input for the stated iteration.

source.place: Proof: canonical internal adjunction via the natural Hom bijections and evaluation/counit formula; relative specialization for proper f

proof.text:
By the evaluation definition of $\eta^Y_M$ and the tensor--Hom bijection,
$$e_{D_YM}\circ(\eta^Y_M\otimes1_{D_YM})=e_M\circ\sigma_{M,D_YM}.$$
Take the tensor--Hom transpose of $a_{D_YM}\circ F\eta^Y_M$, whose target is $D_X(FD_YM)$. By the definition of $a$ in step 3 it is $\rho_{D_YM}\circ(F\eta^Y_M\otimes1_{FD_YM})$. Naturality and symmetry of $\mu$ from step 2, followed by the displayed evaluation identity, compute this map as
$$\begin{aligned}
\rho_{D_YM}(F\eta^Y_M\otimes1)
&=\tau F\bigl(e_{D_YM}(\eta^Y_M\otimes1)\bigr)\mu_{M,D_YM}\\
&=\tau F(e_M\sigma_{M,D_YM})\mu_{M,D_YM}\\
&=\rho_M\sigma_{FM,FD_YM}.
\end{aligned}$$
All terms have domain $FM\otimes FD_YM$ and codomain $K_X$. In particular the symmetry, including its Koszul signs, has not been suppressed from the calculation.

source.place: Tags 08J9 (lemma-internal-hom), 0A97 (lemma-internal-hom-evaluate), 0FPT (lemma-symmetric-monoidal-derived); explicit relative evaluation calculation by the worker

proof.text:
Let $E_A:D_XA\otimes A\to K_X$ be base evaluation. The transpose of $D_X(a_M)\circ\eta^X_{FM}:FM\to D_X(FD_YM)$ is
$$E_{FD_YM}\circ(D_X(a_M)\otimes1)\circ(\eta^X_{FM}\otimes1).$$
Naturality of evaluation in its argument replaces the first two factors by $E_{D_XFM}\circ(1_{D_X^2FM}\otimes a_M)$. The defining identity $E_{D_XFM}(\eta^X_{FM}\otimes1)=E_{FM}\sigma_{FM,D_XFM}$ and naturality of symmetry therefore make this transpose
$$E_{FM}\circ(a_M\otimes1_{FM})\circ\sigma_{FM,FD_YM}=\rho_M\sigma_{FM,FD_YM}.$$
It equals step 4's transpose. Injectivity of the tensor--Hom bijection gives
$$a_{D_YM}\circ F\eta^Y_M=D_X(a_M)\circ\eta^X_{FM}.$$
Compose with $D_X(a_M^{-1})$. Contravariant functoriality gives $D_X(a_M^{-1})D_X(a_M)=1$; thus the result is exactly $b_M\circ F\eta^Y_M=\eta^X_{FM}$. Both factors defining $b_M$ are isomorphisms (step 3 and preservation of inverses by a functor). This uses no invertibility of either $\eta$.

The statement, stmt_deps, blueprint and source fields are byte-identical to the version Q10 created and to the live node (still unsplit). The delivery has no new nodes, no cycle in its closure, and no SGA citation. Source: ILO XVII Prop. 6.4.2, printed p.298 (PDF p.304), 'Rπ⋆C s'identifie au cône du morphisme de bidualité Rπ⋆M → D_X D_X Rπ⋆M'. The item states exactly this, and its only citer, lem-per-biduality-finite-type-propagation, uses it that way. Step 1: proper gives the compactification f∘id, so Rf_!^c = Rf_*; det-sp-unique-right-adjoint identifies f^× with the statement's G. Step 2: I rechecked the adjoints of μ, the symmetry identity, and μ = F(ε⊗1)Π using lem-amb-tensor-projection-adjunct with a = 1. Step 3: lem-asd-internal-adjunction-evaluation with h = 1 gives transpose ρ_M; its Π, read from lem-amb-proper-coproducts-projection, is the same explicit σ/PF composite as π_f, so a_M = α_M is invertible by prop-asd-internal-adjunction (finite ring, Noetherian, compactifiable, arbitrary complexes). Steps 4 and 5: I recomputed both transposes, which equal ρ_M∘σ with Koszul signs kept; the D_X(a^{-1})∘D_X(a) cancellation has the right direction and neither η is inverted. Edge cases checked: f = id, M = 0, r > 1, f finite (consistent with lem-per-potential-finite-bidual-comparison), P¹ → Spec k. The proof does not assume local duality. No duplicate exists: the finite comparison and the relative bidual triangles are narrower, and the internal adjunction lacks the η-compatibility. Accepted tool_uses (generic ambient tools, nothing from the perverse Fourier unit replaced): prop-asd-internal-adjunction, lem-asd-internal-adjunction-evaluation, lem-amb-tensor-projection-adjunct, lem-kun-inverse-image-monoidal, lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal. Advisory 1: step 1 matches the D^+ exceptional adjoint of the finite-pullback lemma with the unbounded G without saying that G preserves D^+ (true because a proper Rf_* has finite cohomological dimension); the pinnings are inherited statement data the proof never uses. Advisory 2: step 3 could name lem-amb-proper-coproducts-projection; it enters only as the definition of Π, through a stmt_dep of the cited evaluation lemma.
